---
id: env.excl.deliberate-non-compliance
type: exclusion
heading: Deliberate Non-compliance
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

A pollution condition arising from your deliberate or intentional failure to comply with environmental law, a licence or a direction of a government authority, by or with the knowledge of a member of your control group. This exclusion applies only after a final adjudication or a written admission establishes the deliberate or intentional failure.
